newsitem.title: USA: L.L. Knickerbocker sees $20 mln in Q4 revs.
newsitem.headline: L.L. Knickerbocker sees $20 mln in Q4 revs.

text.p: L.L. Knickerbocker Co Inc Thursday said it is projecting $20 million in revenues for the fourth quarter and $80 million in revenues for fiscal 1997, with profitability.

In a statement, the company said consolidations are underway on the company's recent acquisitions of Harlyn International Co Inc with annual sales of $10 million and Georgetown Collection Inc and Magic Attic Inc with annual sales of $35 million.

"This company has never been in a healthier state," Chairman Louis Knickerbocker said. "We are on track for virtually every program. Our equity investments in Pure Energy Corporation, Insta-Heat and Self Heating Container are progressing as expected and we remain solidly optimistic as to their future as well as the future of The L.L. Knickerbocker Company."
